periwinkle-flare.$description: Periwinkle Flare — Primary action background, italic emphasis text, active nav state, heading accent — the lone chromatic signal in an otherwise achromatic system, used surgically to make interactions feel switched on

warm-cream.$description: Warm Cream — Primary text, card borders, hairline dividers, card surfaces — a warm off-white that softens the black void and carries the editorial tone

warm-ash.$description: Warm Ash — Secondary card borders, muted text, button borders — a mid-tone warm gray for layering depth between cream borders and the black canvas

charcoal-veil.$description: Charcoal Veil — Subtle borders, low-emphasis dividers, body text borders — the deepest visible neutral for near-invisible structural lines

ibm-plex-serif.$description: Display and heading typeface — weight 300 at 55px creates a whisper-light editorial presence; this serif choice signals PR-agency sophistication and gives the brand a magazine-editorial voice that distinguishes it from typical sans-serif tech sites

ibm-plex-sans.$description: Body, UI, navigation, buttons, captions — the functional workhorse at 16-17px weight 400; weight 300 is used for secondary text creating a light, airy body voice; weight 500 for emphasis and button labels
